[{"insert":"Single Arm Plank + Suitcase Single Leg Standing Calf Raise

Two movements that build stability and lower leg strength to finish the session. The single arm plank removes one point of contact, which demands that the core and shoulder resist lateral rotation. The suitcase single leg calf raise adds a unilateral demand to the calf and requires ankle stability through the full range. Keep the rep tempo slow on the calf raise — three seconds down keeps the calf under tension through the lowering phase.
"}]
